messages:
mona: Hey team — PR #42321 ready for quick review. This is a small hotpatch to the allocator that tweaks eviction behavior for the model pool (prefetch/warmup path). Need runtime + infra + security eyes before canary.

Summary: reduce `pinned_count` default 16 -> 8, add `eviction.force_reclaim` flag (off by default), emit `allocator_evictions_total` metric. No changes to KV cache on-disk format. Test plan + perf numbers in the PR description.

Canary plan: Friday 10:00 PT in us-west1, merge slot 13:00 PT if all clear.

Asking: @kai (runtime), @ashley (infra), @sarah (sec) — PTAL. If you prefer I can split into two PRs but would like to keep atomic for rollout.

kai: taking a look now. quick q — does reducing `pinned_count` risk thrashing for long-sequence customers?

mona: good Q — we only change default for pooled model workers; long-sequence jobs that pin explicitly (via `pin_count` override) are unaffected. Also added a metric and opt-in flag in case we need to revert quickly.

ashley: cc infra — I need to check pinned pages / bpf interactions. Will try to review by EOD. Any baremetal/ebs notes?

mona: no EBS touches. This is allocator in user space. The bpf changes were experimental and not included.

sarah: sec question — any KMS or S3 ACL changes in this PR? Also need to eyeball telemetry to ensure no PII leakage.

mona: no KMS/S3 changes. Telemetry only emits counts and durations (`allocator_evictions_total`, `eviction_latency_ms`). All sanitized.

ci-bot: CI passed — build@main ✅, integration tests green (full allocator suite).

ben: can runtime-oncall own the canary? we should pick a single owner to watch metrics.

jordan: I can own the canary window Friday. Will monitor latency, evictions, and cost metrics.

mona: awesome — thanks @jordan :thumbsup: If anyone finds anything blocking in review, flag it here. Otherwise I'll schedule the canary and add a short runbook (roll back steps + `eviction.force_reclaim=true`) in the PR description.

kai: a couple of inline comments pushed. nothing major but want to make sure the metric tagging is consistent with the rest of runtime.

mona: pushed fixes for tagging. re-requesting review.

ashley: left one infra nit about thread pin limits, but nothing blocking from infra perspective.

sarah: sec ack pending a quick check of telemetry dashboard permissions — should be fine. leaving an LGTM after that.

mona: thanks all. will merge after sec LGTM and Jordan confirms canary owner. I'll post final schedule and the `kubectl` rollout command in this thread.

jordan: confirmed. will be online Friday 09:30 PT.

mona: perfect. cheers everyone.
